text:
The treatment experience was very disappointing.
1. There was no treatment plan or explanation of what would be done. All I knew was that the braces would be adjusted.
Before the appointment, I was informed that I had a wisdom tooth that needed to be extracted. The doctor said it could be removed gradually during orthodontic treatment. Now, 4 months have passed, and I've only been informed about brace adjustments. Today, I came in to ask about the treatment plan and when the wisdom tooth would be removed. Today, I received an answer, but they only reviewed the treatment chart and said it could be removed immediately. They said that if left for too long, some cases might develop pus, and it would be difficult to remove if the orthodontic treatment takes longer.

My question is: #Why wasn't there an appointment, an announcement, a notification, or a check of the tooth beforehand? They just changed the braces and said it was finished.

What I want to say is:
1. I have my own work schedule and timetable. I don't work only during certain hours. I prioritize the clinic's convenience and can schedule appointments.
2. The treatment plan should be clearly explained, not made to the client have to ask. Clients should feel comfortable with the treatment.

Situation 2: Today, I had an appointment with the doctor to have a tooth extracted, so I thought, since I'm already angry, I might as well get it done. During the treatment, I was asked, "Which tooth will be extracted?"

My question is: Where did the initial dental scan and treatment plan go? I was asked which tooth I wanted extracted (I tried to understand that it might have been a way to strike up a conversation and help me relax), but you have to understand that this is my #firsttimeorthodontictreatment. I'm not a dentist, I don't know the procedures or steps involved. I pay the full amount for your services every time, but I'm extremely dissatisfied with this kind of service.

We trusted you and used your services. Please increase our confidence and trust in the treatment you provide.

I apologize to the staff member who had to handle this matter today, as I didn't know who was supposed to handle it. I understand that the staff member didn't have the authority to make the decision. They apologized on my behalf, but I'm still unhappy. I want an explanation from someone with the authority to decide. This review is based on the facts.
